data.name: Rest Here
data.detailed_description:
Build a cozy haven where lanterns glow, taverns bustle, and NPCs gather for festivities.

But when the sun dips, step through the Shadow Lands portal into shifting biomes, brutal enemies, lost kingdoms, and high-risk runs where the longer you stay, the richer (and deadlier) it gets.

Rescue villagers, forge alliances or wage wars, and watch the Shadow Lands adapt to your choices.

Community-made maps slip into the rotation, turning the Shadow Lands into a living, player-forged gauntlet.

When extraction opens, fight back to the portal with whatever you can carry…

Will you cut your losses and bring it home - Or stay one more night and risk it all?

 

Key features

The Haven:

  • A World Worth Coming Home To:  Grow a warm, living settlement that remembers you. Farms, taverns, orchards, workshops, festivals - This is your safe haven.

  • Build Your Legacy: Design and Terraform - From cottages to labyrinths; shape your world tile by tile as your village thrives.

  • Mine, Craft, Fight: Harvest rare ores, forge gear, and specialize in melee, ranged, or arcane play styles.

  • Invent & Engineer: Wire logic circuits, lay railways, automate production, and connect gadgets to make the world your playground.

  • Play at Your Pace: Fish and play bar games between dives, or chase nerve-wracking marathons through the dark. It’s your call.

The Shadow Lands:

  • Push-Your-Luck Runs: Step through the portal into disconnected, shifting realms. The longer you stay, the greater the rewards and the higher the chance you lose it all.

  • Escalating Threats: Time in the Shadows ramps waves and rewards: new enemies, elites, events, and biomes to liberate.

  • Alliances & Wars: Hunt down ruined thrones, buried temples, and siege-bound cities. Forge pacts, open trade routes, or wage wars to seize ground and reshape Shadow territory.

  • Rescue & Recruit: Extract villagers mid-run and return with farmers, smiths, alchemists, wardens each expanding what your town can do.

  • Community-Forged Worlds: Use the Map Editor to design dungeons, strongholds, and wild biomes. The best creations are fed back into the Shadow Lands, letting players explore, survive, and extract from worlds built by the community itself.

data.short_description: Your world above, the ever changing Shadows below: Terraform your world, mine resources, craft gear, fight monsters, make alliances, rescue who you can, extract what you carry. Make it back and your cozy world thrives. Die? and the Shadows keep it all.
